meta.title: Tactical Briefing Boot
meta.description: A deep-space cinematic tactical-briefing boot sequence with a holographic logo uplink and an Ace-Combat-style multi-panel intelligence console: TGT INFO, MISSION DATA, OPERATION INFO, CONTACT ZONE, SAT INFORMATION, SIGHTING DATA, LOGIN INFORMATION, a perspective 3D tactical map, wireframe globe, target lock, near-black levels, ice/cyan key light, ember rim light and film grain. Four phases: logo, boot briefing, operator login, tactical title. MISSION START is removed. About 15 seconds, skippable.
